subtasks.description: Declare all module parameters (BD_SIZE, RAM_MEM_WIDTH, BD_WIDTH, mode selection) and internal state: free_bd counter, m_wr_pnt pointer, s_rd_pnt pointer, last_a_cmp flip-flop, wr_cnt and rd_cnt counters, and the bd_mem storage. Initialize free_bd to half total BDs (32‑bit mode) or quarter (16‑bit mode) per S005. The bd_mem must be flattened into scalar signals to avoid unpacked array synthesis.
constraints: All storage must use simple reg declarations; bd_mem must be flattened into one‑dimensional scalar signals (e.g., bd_mem_0, bd_mem_1, …) and accessed without unpacked arrays, multidimensional references, generate, or genvar.
Interface ports must strictly follow the list in S003: clk, rst, we_m, dat_in_m, free_bd, re_s, ack_o_s, a_cmp, dat_out_s.

subtasks.description: Sequential block managing write operations: on reset, clear m_wr_pnt and wr_cnt; when we_m and free_bd>0, write dat_in_m into the flattened bd_mem[m_wr_pnt], increment m_wr_pnt (wrap at BD_SIZE-1), and advance wr_cnt. In 32‑bit mode complete after 2 writes, in 16‑bit after 4. On completion assert new_bw one cycle and decrement free_bd, resetting wr_cnt.
constraints: All memory writes must use the flattened scalar signal names from B1 (e.g., bd_mem_0, bd_mem_1, …). Do not use dynamic array indexing or generate/genvar; explicitly enumerate cases for each flattened element.
Wrap‑around logic for m_wr_pnt must use simple conditional statements comparing to BD_SIZE-1.

subtasks.description: Sequential block for read pointer management: on reset, clear s_rd_pnt and rd_cnt. When re_s is high, increment s_rd_pnt (wrapping at BD_SIZE-1) and advance rd_cnt. In 32‑bit mode wrap at 2, in 16‑bit at 4; rd_cnt resets automatically on reaching terminal count without external signal.
constraints: Pointer and counter updates must use simple conditional increments with explicit wrap‑around comparisons; do not use generate or genvar.

subtasks.description: Combinational block assigning dat_out_s from the flattened bd_mem at address s_rd_pnt, and generating ack_o_s. In 16‑bit mode, ack_o_s is high when re_s is active; in 32‑bit mode it remains low. Dat_out_s must use a case or mux structure selecting the appropriate flattened scalar signal.
constraints: dat_out_s generation must use an explicit case/mux over s_rd_pnt values, selecting among flattened bd_mem_* scalars, not dynamic array indexing. No generate/genvar.
ack_o_s logic must conditionally assert based on a mode parameter (e.g., MODE_SEL or a derived localparam).

subtasks.description: Sequential block that detects rising edge on a_cmp using last_a_cmp flip-flop. On reset clear last_a_cmp. Each cycle, update last_a_cmp with a_cmp, and if a_cmp is high and last_a_cmp was low, increment free_bd by 1.
constraints: Edge detection must be implemented with a single‑bit last_a_cmp register and simple combinational comparison; do not use generate or genvar.
